mono.purpose: Machine-produced values only: pipeline stages, hashes, byte sizes, offsets.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Hover/active color transitions on buttons and pills.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Terracotta fill, near-black text — the one saturated element per view (primary CTA, active redaction mode).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: hsl(28 92% 54%); color: hsl(20 40% 10%); font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.875rem; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 6px; border: none; transition: background 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: hsl(28 92% 48%); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid hsl(28 92% 54%); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action sitting beside a primary button — hairline border, no fill.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background: hsl(222 22% 7%); color: hsl(210 20% 96%); font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.875rem; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid hsl(222 15% 18%); transition: background 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: hsl(222 15% 17%); }

components.name: Card
components.description: The system's only elevation cue: one lightness step above the page background plus a hairline border, never a shadow.
components.html:
Extract anything
PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, CSV and plain text are converted to clean markdown with a layout map.
components.css: .ds-card { background: hsl(222 20% 10%); color: hsl(210 20% 96%); border: 1px solid hsl(222 15% 18%); border-radius: 8px; padding: 24px; } .ds-card-title { font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 6px; } .ds-card-body { color: hsl(215 12% 62%); font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.5; }

components.name: Badge
components.description: Fully rounded, no fill — text color alone carries meaning (muted/neutral, emerald/done, primary/active).
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border: 1px solid hsl(222 15% 18%); border-radius: 9999px; padding: 2px 10px; font-size: 0.75rem; color: hsl(215 12% 62%); background: transparent; }

components.name: Pipeline Stage Pill
components.description: Signature component: a monospace, square-cornered pill whose border color encodes pipeline state (pending/active/done). The mono font is itself the signal that this text is a machine-produced token, not prose.
components.html: extractnerpiiredact
components.css: .ds-stage-row { display: flex; gap: 6px; } .ds-stage { font-family: 'SF Mono', 'Fira Code', 'Fira Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.6875rem; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid hsl(222 15% 18%); color: hsl(215 12% 62%); } .ds-stage--active { border-color: hsl(28 92% 54%); color: hsl(28 92% 54%); } .ds-stage--done { border-color: hsla(162 72% 46% / 0.4); color: oklch(69.6% 0.17 162.48); }

components.name: Tab Bar
components.description: Underline-free segmented control. Inactive tabs sit in a muted pill; the active tab lifts to the page background with foreground text — the lift itself is the only active signal.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: inline-flex; gap: 2px; background: hsl(222 15% 14%); border-radius: 8px; padding: 3px; } .ds-tab { font-size: 0.875rem; padding: 5px 12px; border-radius: 6px; border: none; background: transparent; color: hsl(215 12% 62%); } .ds-tab--active { background: hsl(222 22% 7%); color: hsl(210 20% 96%); }

narrative.overview:
Hacienda Studio looks like a piece of trusted infrastructure, not a marketing surface — closer to a well-built ops console or a security appliance's admin panel than a SaaS dashboard. The palette is a single near-black charcoal-navy with one warm, unapologetic accent: a terracotta orange that reads as "trust this, act on this," never decorative. Everything else sits in a narrow band of desaturated cool grays that never compete with that accent.

The interface earns its calm by being honest about what's happening: pipeline stages render as literal monospace tokens, findings show real confidence percentages, and the audit tab prints raw hash values rather than a friendly checkmark. This is a tool for people who need to trust it, not be charmed by it — but it isn't cold: rounded corners and a warm accent keep it from reading as a bare terminal.
keyCharacteristics: Single accent color, used sparingly — primary actions, active state, and nothing else
Monospace for anything that is literally a system token
Flat, bordered surfaces — no shadows, one step of lightness is the only depth cue
Generous whitespace on Landing, dense and edge-to-edge on tool surfaces

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Terracotta orange appears on buttons/active-states/small icon marks only — never as a background fill, never on more than one element's "primary" state at a time.

rules.name: The Mono-Means-Machine Rule
rules.body: If a value was produced by the pipeline rather than typed by a human, it renders in the mono stack. Prose never does.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: A new surface never gets a shadow to "lift" it. If it needs to read as elevated, give it the card background + border combination instead.

dos: Do keep terracotta orange to a single active element per view
Do render any pipeline-produced value in the mono stack
Do use the card + hairline-border combination for distinct surfaces, never a shadow
Do keep tool surfaces dense and edge-to-edge; reserve generous whitespace for Landing
donts: Don't add a second saturated accent color
Don't add shadows, blur, or glassmorphism anywhere
Don't use the mono font for anything a human wrote
Don't center tool-surface content in a narrow column the way Landing does
